author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: You have a new email from the senior partner with a research assignment on the Dixon FLSA matter. Check your inbox, read the full request, and handle everything as described. Carry everything out with tool actions -- do not merely write up what should happen. Save the completed work product as a court filing in the matter system.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a wage-and-hour litigation associate at Adler Bennett PC. You specialize in FLSA and state wage claims. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- Statutory and regulatory databases
- The firm's matter management system and document vault
- Legal drafting and suggestion tools
- Gmail for attorney communications (your address: research@adlerbennett.com)
- Slack for team updates
